title: Ukufunda indawo yakho
description: Chonga ukuhamba kwamanzi, ukuma kwelanga, iindlela zomoya nokumila komhlaba kwindawo yakho.

lessons.title: Ukuqonda ukuhamba kwamanzi: apho imvula iya khona emhlabeni wakho
lessons.body:
Phambi kokuba uqokelele amanzi, funda ukuba asele eya phi na. Khangela ukusuka kwindawo ekhuselekileyo ngexesha lemvula enkulu. Xa kukhuselekile emva koko, hamba emhlabeni wakho. Khangela ii-rill (imisele emincinci yamanzi), iindawo apho amanzi asasazeka khona, apho eqokelelana khona, nalapho ephuma khona emhlabeni wakho. Amanzi athile agqithisileyo adinga indlela ekhuselekileyo yokuhamba kude ukuze angabangeli monakalo.

I-A-frame level (isixhobo esimile ngonobumba A esinceda ukufumana iindawo ezilingana ngokuphakama) inokukunceda uphawule amanqaku akwisithuba esinye sokuphakama kwaye ulandele umgca wokuphakama. Iimpawu zayo kukuqwalasela kuphela, asiso isicwangciso okanye imvume yemisebenzi yokumba umhlaba. Phambi kokumba i-swale (umsele wokubamba amanzi ecaleni komgca wokuphakama), idama, okanye esinye isakhiwo, cela indawo yakho ivavanywe. Umhlaba, ithambeka, ukuphuma kwamanzi, ukuhamba kwamanzi emvula enkulu, nendlela ekhuselekileyo yokuphuma kwamanzi agqithisileyo zonke ziyabalulekile. Buza umcebisi wasekuhlaleni oqeqeshiweyo.

Akukho mgaqo mnye wokubeka olandelwa kuwo onke amathambeka. Khangela apho amanzi ahamba khona aze aqokelelane. Imigca yokuphakama ebekwe kakubi inokunyusa ukukhukuliseka komhlaba, kwaye umhlaba ofunxa amanzi kancinci unokubamba amanzi amaninzi kakhulu. Khetha nayiphi na imisebenzi yamanzi efanelekileyo kwindawo yakho kwaye ucwangcise indlela ekhuselekileyo yamanzi agqithisileyo.
keyPoints: Khangela ukusuka kwindawo ekhuselekileyo ngexesha lemvula, ze uhambe emhlabeni xa kukhuselekile
I-A-frame inokuphawula amanqaku akwisithuba esinye sokuphakama, kodwa ayibonisi ukuba imisebenzi yokumba umhlaba iyafaneleka
Imisebenzi yamanzi neendlela ezikhuselekileyo zamanzi agqithisileyo zidinga uvavanyo lwendawo
Amanzi athile agqithisileyo adinga indlela ekhuselekileyo yokuhamba kude ukuthintela umonakalo

options: Amanqaku akwisithuba esinye sokuphakama ecaleni komgca wokuphakama
Ukuba ngaba i-swale ikhuselekile ukuyakha kweli thambeka
Amanzi emvula enkulu amaninzi kangakanani umhlaba onokuwafunxa
Apho i-spillway (indlela yokuphuma kwamanzi edameni) kufuneka yakhiwe khona
quiz.rationale: I-A-frame inokunceda uphawule amanqaku akwisithuba esinye sokuphakama. Ayivavanyi umhlaba, ukuphuma kwamanzi, ukuhamba kwamanzi emvula enkulu, okanye ukuba imisebenzi yokumba umhlaba iyafaneleka na.

quiz.q: Ubona amanzi ehamba ngokukhawuleza phezu komhlaba kwindawo enethambeka e-KZN. Kufuneka wenze ntoni phambi kokumba isakhiwo samanzi?
options: Sibeke phezulu kangangoko kunokwenzeka ethambekeni
Jonga umhlaba, ithambeka, ukuphuma kwamanzi nokuhamba kwamanzi emvula enkulu, kwaye ucwangcise indlela ekhuselekileyo yamanzi agqithisileyo kunye nomcebisi wasekuhlaleni oqeqeshiweyo
Sibeke apho amanzi avela khona kuqala
Landela umgaqo ofanayo wophezulu, ophakathi nowasezantsi osetyenziswa kwezinye iifama
quiz.rationale: Umgaqo wokubeka awunakubonisa ukuba isakhiwo sifanelekile na kwindawo. Imigca yokuphakama ebekwe kakubi inokunyusa ukukhukuliseka komhlaba, kwaye amanzi agqithisileyo adinga indlela ekhuselekileyo.

lessons.infographicAlt: Icala lenduli lijongwa ecaleni, kunye nemicibisholo ebonisa apho imvula ihla khona ethambekeni, apho iqokelelana khona kwindawo ephantsi, nalapho ifunxeka khona xa umhlaba uthe tyaba.

lessons.title: Ukuma kwelanga, umthunzi kunye ne-aspect: ukusebenzisa kakuhle ukukhanya kwelanga
lessons.body:
Kwiindawo ezininzi zoMzantsi Afrika, ingakumbi ebusika, ilanga likumntla. Indlela yalo itshintsha ngexesha lonyaka nangokwendawo okuyo. Amathambeka ajonge emntla ahlala efumana ilanga elininzi kwaye anokushisa aze omile ngakumbi. Amathambeka ajonge emzantsi ahlala epholile kwaye enomswakama ngakumbi. Iqabaka linokuqokelelana kwiindawo eziphantsi apho umoya obandayo uhlala khona. Jonga indawo yakho ngokwakho phambi kokukhetha apho uza kutyala izityalo ezithambileyo okanye ubeke izakhiwo.

Ilanga lasebusika liphantsi kwaye likude ngakumbi emntla kunelanga lasehlotyeni. Udonga okanye ilaphu lomthunzi lunganika ibhedi umthunzi ixesha elide ebusika kunasehlotyeni. Phambi kokubeka nantoni na ehlala ixesha elide, yima kuloo ndawo nge-8am, emini, nge-4pm ngosuku lwasebusika uze ubone apho umthunzi uwela khona.

I-pawpaw nemithi emincinci ye-citrus (imithi yeziqhamo) iyaziva iqabaka. Gcina izityalo ezithambileyo kude neendawo eziphantsi ezaziwayo apho iqabaka liqokelelana khona. Jonga iqabaka lasekuhlaleni phambi kokutyala.
keyPoints: Amathambeka ajonge emntla ahlala efumana ilanga elithe ngqo ngakumbi; amathambeka ajonge emzantsi ahlala epholile kwaye enomswakama ngakumbi
Ilanga lasebusika liphantsi kwaye likude ngakumbi emntla; jonga umthunzi wasekuhlaleni phambi kokwakha
Umoya obandayo unokuqokelelana kwiindawo eziphantsi; i-aspect yenye kuphela yezinto zendawo
Jonga iqabaka lasekuhlaleni phambi kokubeka i-pawpaw ethambileyo okanye i-citrus encinci

quiz.q: Umfama makakhangele phi kuqala indawo ye-pawpaw encinci eziva iqabaka kwifama encinci yaseHighveld?
options: Indawo esezantsi kakhulu apho umoya obandayo uqokelelana khona
Indawo ephantsi ebandayo enomthunzi
Indawo enelanga ngaphandle kwendawo ephantsi eyaziwayo yeqabaka, emva kokujonga indlela iqabaka elisebenza ngayo kwindawo
Indawo ekhethwe ngaphandle kokujonga indawo
quiz.rationale: Umoya obandayo unokuqokelelana kwiindawo eziphantsi. Indawo enelanga ngakumbi ngaphandle kwendawo eyaziwayo yeqabaka inokunciphisa umngcipheko, kodwa into ejongwe kwiqabaka lasekuhlaleni kufuneka ikhokele ukubeka kokugqibela.

quiz.q: Umfama ucwangcisa ilaphu lomthunzi kwicala lasemntla legadi lakhe. Kufuneka ajonge ntoni phambi kokulilungisa endaweni?
options: Apho isithunzi salo siwela khona ebhedini ebusika
Ukuba ludlulisela iqabaka kude na
Ukuba ilanga lihlala liphezu kweentloko emini na
Kuphela ukuba linciphisa ukuhwamla kwamanzi ehlotyeni na
quiz.rationale: Ilanga lasebusika liphantsi kwaye likude ngakumbi emntla. Ilaphu lomthunzi linokutshintsha iiyure zelanga ebhedini. Jonga izithunzi zokwenyani nge-8am, emini, nge-4pm phambi kokulilungisa endaweni.

lessons.infographicAlt: Ithambeka elinelanga emntla. Izithunzi zesakhiwo nezomthi ziwela emzantsi, zihle ethambekeni.

lessons.title: Umoya, iqabaka nokumila komhlaba: ukufunda amandla angabonwayo
lessons.body:
Umoya unokonakalisa izityalo kwifama encinci. Icala nokomelela komoya onokonakalisa kutshintsha ngommandla, ngexesha lonyaka, nangemiqolo yeentaba nezithuba zendawo yakho. Hamba emhlabeni wakho ngeentsuku ezinomoya. Rekhoda apho umoya uvela khona nento echatshazelwa nguwo. Jonga iirekhodi zemozulu zasekuhlaleni phambi kokugqiba ukuba isikhuselo sidingeka phi.

Ebusuku obucacileyo, obuthe cwaka, umoya obandayo unokuhamba ethambekeni ehla uze uqokelelane kwiindawo eziphantsi. Ezi ndawo zinokubanda kunamathambeka aziingqongileyo. Iindlela zeqabaka nazo zixhomekeke kwindawo. Thelekisa iindawo onokuzikhetha kwixesha leqabaka lasekuhlaleni. Jonga iirekhodi zobushushu obuphantsi kakhulu lasekuhlaleni apho zikhoyo. Ukuba iirekhodi aziko, qhubeka ujonga ebusuku obubandayo uze ubuze umcebisi wezolimo wasekuhlaleni phambi kokukhetha ikhaya elisisigxina lezityalo ezincinci ezithambileyo (seedlings).

Iqabaka ngumkhenkce owenzeka kumphezulu obandayo. Inkungu yodwa ayibonisi ukuba umkhenkce wenzekile, kwaye umonakalo weqabaka unokwenzeka ngaphandle komkhenkce obonakalayo. Khangela umkhenkce nomonakalo wezityalo, thelekisa umhlaba ophantsi namathambeka, uze ujonge ubushushu obuphantsi kakhulu apho ukwazi. Phawula iindawo apho ukubanda okanye umonakalo kuhlala ixesha elide. Gcina izityalo ezibucayi kude neendawo ezibandayo ozibonileyo.

Kutamatisi onengxaki ye-late blight (isifo sezityalo setamatisi), ukuhamba komoya nelanga lekuseni kunganceda amagqabi omile. I-late blight isenokusasazeka ngexesha lemozulu ebandayo, enomswakama exesha elide. Ukuhambisa ibhedi kodwa akuyi kuyilawula; funa nesikhokelo sasekuhlaleni sempilo yezityalo.
keyPoints: Jonga icala lomoya onokonakalisa kwindawo yakho phambi kokubeka isikhuselo
Umoya obandayo unokuhla ethambekeni ebusuku obucacileyo, obuthe cwaka uze uqokelelane kumhlaba ophantsi
Thelekisa umonakalo wezityalo ebusuku obubandayo nobushushu kwindawo yakho yonke; iqabaka elibonakalayo asilo kuphela uphawu
Ukuhamba komoya nokoma kunganceda ukunciphisa amagqabi amanzi, kodwa akwaneli ukulawula i-late blight

quiz.q: Umfama makakhangele phi kuqala xa ebeka indawo yokuzalela izityalo ezincinci eziva iqabaka kwifama encinci yaseHighveld?
options: Indawo eyaziwayo yeqabaka ezantsi entlambo
Umqolo ovulekileyo ngaphandle kokujonga umoya
Indawo enelanga, ekhuselekileyo ngaphandle kwendawo ephantsi eqaphelweyo yeqabaka, emva kokujonga indlela yobusuku obubandayo kwindawo
Indawo enomthunzi omninzi kakhulu, ngaphandle kokujonga iqabaka
quiz.rationale: Umoya obandayo unokuhlala kwiindawo eziphantsi ebusuku obucacileyo, obuthe cwaka. Thelekisa iindawo onokuzikhetha zokuzalela izityalo ezincinci kwixesha leqabaka lasekuhlaleni. Jonga iirekhodi zobushushu obuphantsi kakhulu lasekuhlaleni okanye buza umcebisi wezolimo wasekuhlaleni phambi kokwenza ukhetho olusisigxina. Iqabaka elibonakalayo asilo kuphela uphawu lomonakalo weqabaka, kwaye akukho ndawo yenduli iqinisekisa ukungabikho kweqabaka.

quiz.q: Utamatisi womfama we-KZN uhlala ufumana i-late blight ngexesha lemozulu ebandayo, enomswakama. Yeyiphi indawo yebhedi enokunceda amagqabi omile, kunye nengcebiso yasekuhlaleni yempilo yezityalo?
options: Itonela evaliweyo, engenawo umoya
Indawo enomoya ohamba kakuhle nelanga lekuseni
Indawo esezantsi ecaleni kwedama
Udonga lwasemzantsi olunomthunzi
quiz.rationale: Ukuhamba komoya nelanga lekuseni kunganceda amagqabi omile. I-late blight ikhuthazwa yimozulu ebandayo, enomswakama exesha elide, kwaye ukuhambisa ibhedi kodwa asisicwangciso esipheleleyo solawulo.

lessons.infographicAlt: Ifama ibonwa ngaphezulu, kunye nemicibisholo ebonisa icala lomoya, umoya obandayo uhla ethambekeni uye kwindawo ephantsi yeqabaka, necala lethambeka.

lessons.title: Ukwenza imephu elula yendawo: uyilo lwakho luqala emaphepheni
lessons.body:
Imephu yendawo idinga iphepha, itheyiphu yokulinganisa, ikhampasi, nexesha lokuhamba emhlabeni wakho. Hamba ngomda uze wenze umzobo wokuqala. Wubhale 'awulinganiswanga' de uhlole imigama yawo. Phawula emntla. Yongeza indlu, imithi, amanzi, iindlela, iifensi. Zoba imicibisholo yomoya wasehlotyeni nowasebusika, iindlela zomthunzi, nalapho amanzi ahamba khona xa kunetha.

Qaphela apho iqabaka lihlala ixesha elide, apho umhlaba unuka ukumanzi ngeenyanga ezomileyo, nalapho i-khakibos okanye i-blackjack ikhula ngokuxineneyo. Ezi zityalo zinokukhula kwiindawo ezothusiweyo, kodwa ukubakho kwazo kodwa akubonisi ukuba umhlaba uxinene na. Hlola umhlaba phambi kokugqiba ukuba loo ndawo ithetha ntoni kuyilo lwakho.

Faka iindawo (zones) neesektha (sectors) zakho phezu komzobo ofanayo. Wuhlaziye ixesha ngalinye lonyaka. Umzobo wepensile osebenzisayo ngokwenene ubaluleke ngakumbi kunalowo ugqibeleleyo owenziwe kanye.
keyPoints: Imephu yendawo idinga kuphela iphepha, itheyiphu yokulinganisa, ikhampasi, nokuqwalasela
Phawula ukuhamba kwamanzi, icala lomoya, iindawo zeqabaka, nezityalo ezikhoyo
Phawula ukukhula okuxineneyo kwe-khakibos okanye i-blackjack ukuze uhlole umhlaba ngakumbi; akubonisi ukuxinana komhlaba
Faka iindawo neesektha phezu kwemephu yakho esisiseko ukugqiba isakhelo soyilo

quiz.q: Ubona i-blackjack ekhula ngokuxineneyo kwikona enye minyaka le. Kufuneka wenze ntoni emva koko?
options: Umhlaba apho uvundile ngokukhethekileyo
Loo ndawo inamanzi angaphantsi komhlaba aphezulu
Phawula indawo uze uhlole umhlaba; isityalo kodwa asinakubonisa ukuxinana komhlaba
I-blackjack ikhula kuphela emthunzini, ngoko kukho umthombo omncinci wamanzi ofihlakeleyo
quiz.rationale: I-blackjack inokukhula kumhlaba othe wothuswa, kodwa ukubakho kwayo kodwa akubonisi ukuxinana komhlaba. Jonga uze uhlole umhlaba phambi kokugqiba ukuba indawo leyo ithetha ntoni kuyilo lwakho.

quiz.q: Kutheni uphawula umoya wasehlotyeni nowasebusika ngokwahlukeneyo kwimephu yendawo yakho?
options: Icala lomoya alitshintshi eMzantsi Afrika
Zinokuvela emacaleni ahlukeneyo, zitshintshe apho izikhuseli zomoya nezityalo ezithambileyo kufuneka zibekwe khona
Umoya ubalulekile ebusika kuphela eHighveld
Icala lomoya lichaphazela izakhiwo kuphela
quiz.rationale: Ukutshintsha komoya ngamaxesha onyaka kuthetha ukuba isikhuselo somoya okanye indawo yesityalo esebenza kwixesha elinye inokuba kukungalunganga kwelinye — ngoko zombini kufuneka ziphawulwe ngokwahlukeneyo.

lessons.infographicAlt: Imephu yendawo etsalwe ngesandla ephepheni ebonisa emntla, izakhiwo, amanzi, nomda — engagudisiwe, njengoko umfama anokuyizoba.
